manifest.description: Fetch an http(s) page, extract readable content, and return a summary plus local artifact references.

waitForRender.description: Accepted for cross-host compatibility; CLI static HTTP fetch cannot render client JavaScript.

provenance: Actual existing TS static HTTP engine, Provider and ArtifactStore. Native explicit deltas retain safe scalar boundaries and report prior engine truncation; stable HTTP/content errors do not disclose transport secrets.
